title: Indian Hasty Manchego Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious bowl dish that combines the spices of India with the richness of Manchego cheese.

ingredients.name: Roasted Vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, zucchini, and bell peppers

instructions: Heat the Hasty Broth in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the Quinoa and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
While the Quinoa cooks, heat the Indian Spice Blend in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Roasted Vegetables and cook until heated through.
Stir in the Manchego Cheese until melted and well combined.
Fluff the cooked Quinoa with a fork and add to the skillet with the vegetable mixture.
Stir in the Fresh Cilantro and Lime Juice.
